scenarios.name: Public Gallery Keyset Cursor Pagination (Deep Page)
scenarios.notes: Replaced OFFSET 1000 with WHERE (created_at < ? OR (created_at = ? AND id < ?)) using composite index idx_images_published_created.

scenarios.name: Public Directory Cache Hit
scenarios.notes: Replaced SELECT DISTINCT author full scan (18,056 rows) with single D1 storage_stats directory_version read (1 row) and scoped Workers Cache API.

scenarios.name: Admin Overview Media Counts Aggregation
scenarios.notes: Replaced fetching all 18,056 r2_keys strings into memory with O(1) table aggregation SELECT SUM(photo_count), SUM(video_count) FROM images.

scenarios.name: Admin Author Stats Group By Aggregation
scenarios.notes: Replaced full 18,056 row JS loop with SQL GROUP BY author SELECT SUM(photo_count), SUM(video_count) (85 rows for 85 distinct authors).

scenarios.name: Search Page-First Subquery & Tag Tagging
scenarios.notes: Bounded tag and author searches with CTE page-first selection before joining tag lists and sanitizing author handles.
